page_texts.3:
[decisions/technology/ADR-TEC-002-ea-documentation-store.md#decision-summary]

## Decision Summary

Adopt GitHub as the primary storage and version control platform for Enterprise Architecture documentation, providing centralized source control, collaboration workflows, and integration with automated publishing pipelines.

---
page_texts.5:
[decisions/technology/ADR-TEC-002-ea-documentation-store.md#business-context]

### Business Context

The Enterprise Architecture team needs a reliable, scalable, and collaborative platform to store, version, and manage all documentation assets including Architecture Decision Records, Root Cause Analyses, standards, and reference materials. The solution must support multiple contributors, maintain comprehensive change history, and integrate seamlessly with automated publishing workflows.
page_texts.6:
[decisions/technology/ADR-TEC-002-ea-documentation-store.md#technical-context]

### Technical Context

Current documentation storage challenges:

- Fragmented storage across multiple platforms and local drives
- Limited version control and change tracking
- Inconsistent collaboration workflows
- No centralized access control or permissions management
- Difficult integration with automated publishing systems
- Poor visibility into content changes and contributor activity
page_texts.7:
[decisions/technology/ADR-TEC-002-ea-documentation-store.md#problem-statement]

### Problem Statement

How can a centralized, version-controlled documentation repository be established that enables effective collaboration, maintains comprehensive change history, provides appropriate access controls, and integrates seamlessly with the MkDocs publishing platform (ADR-TEC-001)?
page_texts.8:
[decisions/technology/ADR-TEC-002-ea-documentation-store.md#decision-drivers]

### Decision Drivers

- ⚡ **Version Control**: Complete history of all documentation changes with branch and merge workflows
- 👥 **Collaboration**: Multi-contributor workflows with review processes and conflict resolution
- 🔒 **Access Management**: Enterprise-grade permissions and security controls
- 🤖 **AI Engineering Access**: Direct repository access enables AI systems to consume and analyze documentation
- 📊 **Business Process Integration**: API-driven access supports automated business workflows and reporting
- 🔗 **Integration**: Seamless integration with MkDocs publishing pipeline (ADR-TEC-001)
- 💾 **Backup & Recovery**: Reliable data protection and disaster recovery capabilities
- 🔍 **Search & Discovery**: Comprehensive search across all documentation content
- 🚀 **Workflow Automation**: Integration with CI/CD pipelines and automated processes
- 📋 **Enterprise Compliance**: SOX, HIPAA, and enterprise security requirements

---
page_texts.10:
[decisions/technology/ADR-TEC-002-ea-documentation-store.md#github-enterprise-with-private-repository]

### GitHub Enterprise with Private Repository

**Description**: Use GitHub Enterprise with a private repository to store all Enterprise Architecture documentation in Markdown format, providing comprehensive version control, collaboration workflows, and enterprise security features.

**Repository Structure**:

```plaintext
eap-ref-architecture/
├── decisions/
│   ├── technology/
│   ├── security/
│   ├── business/
│   └── infrastructure/
├── rcas/
│   ├── technology/
│   ├── security/
│   └── operational/
├── domains/
├── guiding-principles/
├── foundation/
├── job-descriptions/
├── onboarding/
├── strategy/
└── assets/
    ├── images/
    ├── diagrams/
    └── templates/
```

**Core Features**:

- **Git Version Control**: Complete change history with branching and merging capabilities
- **Collaborative Workflows**: Pull request reviews, branch protection, and merge policies
- **Access Controls**: Role-based permissions with enterprise SSO integration
- **Issue Tracking**: Integrated issue management for documentation requests and improvements
- **GitHub Actions**: Automated workflows for validation, publishing, and notifications
- **Security Scanning**: Automated security scanning and vulnerability detection
- **Backup**: Distributed version control provides inherent backup and recovery

**Pros**:

- ✅ **Industry Standard**: Git is the de facto standard for version control and collaboration
- ✅ **Enterprise Features**: GitHub Enterprise provides SOC 2, HIPAA-compliant hosting
- ✅ **AI Engineering Integration**: Direct API access enables AI systems to consume, analyze, and process documentation
- ✅ **Business Process Automation**: GitHub APIs support automated workflows, reporting, and business intelligence
- ✅ **Workflow Integration**: Seamless integration with MkDocs publishing (ADR-TEC-001)
- ✅ **Access Control**: Granular permissions with enterprise SSO and audit logging
- ✅ **Collaboration**: Proven workflows for multi-contributor documentation projects
- ✅ **Automation**: GitHub Actions enable sophisticated CI/CD workflows
- ✅ **Search**: Built-in repository search across all content and history
- ✅ **Backup**: Distributed nature provides automatic backup and disaster recovery

**Cons**:

- ❌ **Learning Curve**: Team members need Git proficiency for effective collaboration
- ❌ **Complexity**: Advanced workflows require understanding of Git branching strategies
- ❌ **Platform Dependency**: Vendor lock-in to GitHub platform and ecosystem

---
page_texts.12:
[decisions/technology/ADR-TEC-002-ea-documentation-store.md#option-1-sharepoint-document-library]

### Option 1: SharePoint Document Library

**Description**: Microsoft SharePoint with document library for centralized storage

**Pros**:

- ✅ **Enterprise Integration**: Native integration with Microsoft 365 ecosystem
- ✅ **User Familiarity**: Most team members already familiar with SharePoint
- ✅ **Version History**: Built-in version control and document history
- ✅ **Permissions**: Detailed permission management and access controls

**Cons**:

- ❌ **Poor Markdown Support**: Limited support for Markdown editing and preview
- ❌ **Integration Challenges**: Difficult integration with MkDocs publishing pipeline
- ❌ **Version Control**: Inferior version control compared to Git workflows
- ❌ **Collaboration**: Limited support for structured review and merge processes
page_texts.13:
[decisions/technology/ADR-TEC-002-ea-documentation-store.md#option-2-confluence]

### Option 2: Confluence

**Description**: Atlassian Confluence as documentation storage and collaboration platform

**Pros**:

- ✅ **Documentation Focus**: Purpose-built for documentation and knowledge management
- ✅ **Rich Editor**: WYSIWYG editing with advanced formatting capabilities
- ✅ **Collaboration**: Built-in commenting, reviewing, and approval workflows
- ✅ **Search**: Advanced search capabilities across all content

**Cons**:

- ❌ **Markdown Limitations**: Poor Markdown support and Git integration
- ❌ **Migration Effort**: Significant effort to convert existing Markdown content
- ❌ **Cost**: High licensing costs for enterprise use
- ❌ **Vendor Lock-in**: Proprietary format makes future migration difficult
page_texts.14:
[decisions/technology/ADR-TEC-002-ea-documentation-store.md#option-3-gitlab]

### Option 3: GitLab

**Description**: GitLab as alternative Git-based platform with integrated CI/CD

**Pros**:

- ✅ **Git-Based**: Full Git version control with similar workflows to GitHub
- ✅ **Integrated CI/CD**: Built-in continuous integration and deployment
- ✅ **Self-Hosted Option**: Can be hosted on-premises for additional control
- ✅ **Issue Management**: Comprehensive issue tracking and project management

**Cons**:

- ❌ **Platform Switching**: Would require migration from existing GitHub familiarity
- ❌ **Ecosystem**: Smaller ecosystem of integrations compared to GitHub
- ❌ **Learning Curve**: Different interface and workflows from GitHub standard
page_texts.15:
[decisions/technology/ADR-TEC-002-ea-documentation-store.md#option-4-azure-devops-repos]

### Option 4: Azure DevOps Repos

**Description**: Microsoft Azure DevOps with Git repositories

**Pros**:

- ✅ **Microsoft Integration**: Native integration with Microsoft enterprise tools
- ✅ **Git-Based**: Full Git version control capabilities
- ✅ **Enterprise Features**: Advanced security and compliance features
- ✅ **Cost**: Potentially lower cost with existing Microsoft licensing

**Cons**:

- ❌ **Limited Ecosystem**: Smaller third-party integration ecosystem
- ❌ **Interface**: Less intuitive interface compared to GitHub
- ❌ **Community**: Smaller community and documentation resources

---
page_texts.16:
[decisions/technology/ADR-TEC-002-ea-documentation-store.md#decision-outcome]

## Decision Outcome

**Chosen Option**: **GitHub Enterprise with Private Repository** (Recommended Option)

**Rationale**: GitHub provides the optimal combination of enterprise-grade version control, collaboration workflows, security features, and ecosystem integration. The platform's native Git support, combined with GitHub Actions automation and seamless MkDocs integration, creates a comprehensive documentation management solution that meets all technical and business requirements.

page_texts.18:
[decisions/technology/ADR-TEC-002-ea-documentation-store.md#repository-configuration]

#### Repository Configuration

**Repository Settings**:

- **Visibility**: Private repository with enterprise access controls
- **Branch Protection**: Main branch protection with required reviews
- **Security**: Dependency scanning, secret scanning, and code scanning enabled
- **Backup**: Automated repository backups and disaster recovery procedures

**Access Management**:

- **Teams**: Enterprise Architecture team with admin access
- **Contributors**: Document authors with write access via pull requests
- **Reviewers**: Senior architects with review and approval permissions
- **Readers**: Broader organization with read-only access as needed
page_texts.19:
[decisions/technology/ADR-TEC-002-ea-documentation-store.md#workflow-configuration]

#### Workflow Configuration

**Branch Strategy**:

- **Main Branch**: Production-ready documentation deployed to website
- **Feature Branches**: Individual document updates and new content
- **Review Process**: Required pull request reviews before merging
- **Release Process**: Automated deployment to MkDocs upon merge to main

**Automation Workflows**:

```yaml
# .github/workflows/documentation.yml
name: Documentation Management
on:
    pull_request:
        paths: ['**.md']
    push:
        branches: [main]

jobs:
    validate:
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        steps:
            - uses: actions/checkout@v3
            - name: Lint Markdown
              uses: DavidAnson/markdownlint-cli2-action@v9
            - name: Check Links
              uses: gaurav-nelson/github-action-markdown-link-check@v1

    publish:
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
        needs: validate
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        steps:
            - uses: actions/checkout@v3
            - name: Deploy MkDocs
              run: |
                  pip install mkdocs-material
                  mkdocs gh-deploy --force
```
page_texts.20:
[decisions/technology/ADR-TEC-002-ea-documentation-store.md#integration-features]

#### Integration Features

**MkDocs Integration**:

- **Source**: Repository serves as single source of truth for MkDocs content
- **Automation**: GitHub Actions automatically rebuilds website on content changes
- **Preview**: Pull request previews for content validation before publication

**Notification System**:

- **Email Alerts**: Automated notifications for significant documentation updates
- **Slack Integration**: Channel notifications for new ADRs and major changes
- **Review Requests**: Automated assignment of reviewers based on content type
page_texts.21:
[decisions/technology/ADR-TEC-002-ea-documentation-store.md#ai-engineering-and-business-process-integration]

#### AI Engineering and Business Process Integration

**AI System Access**:

- **GitHub API Integration**: Direct programmatic access to repository content for AI consumption
- **RAG System Support**: Repository structure optimized for Retrieval-Augmented Generation workflows
- **Knowledge Graph Construction**: Git history and file relationships enable automated knowledge mapping
- **Document Analysis**: AI systems can analyze documentation patterns, gaps, and compliance

**Business Process Automation**:

- **Automated Reporting**: GitHub APIs enable automated generation of architecture reports and summaries
- **Compliance Monitoring**: Automated checking of documentation standards and completeness
- **Change Impact Analysis**: AI-driven analysis of how documentation changes affect business processes
- **Decision Support**: Historical decision patterns and outcomes available for business intelligence

**Enterprise Integration Capabilities**:

- **PowerBI Integration**: Repository data can feed business intelligence dashboards
- **ServiceNow Integration**: Documentation changes can trigger IT service management workflows
- **Confluence Sync**: Selective synchronization with enterprise wiki platforms for broader access
- **Audit Trail Integration**: Complete change history supports regulatory and compliance reporting

page_texts.23:
[decisions/technology/ADR-TEC-002-ea-documentation-store.md#-risks]

### ⚠️ Risks

- **Git Learning Curve**: Team members unfamiliar with Git workflows may struggle with collaboration processes
- **Workflow Complexity**: Advanced branching and merging strategies could create barriers to contribution
- **Platform Dependency**: Vendor lock-in to GitHub could limit future platform flexibility
- **Repository Management**: Poor repository hygiene could lead to merge conflicts and workflow inefficiencies
page_texts.24:
[decisions/technology/ADR-TEC-002-ea-documentation-store.md#-mitigations]

### 🛡️ Mitigations

- **Comprehensive Training**: Structured Git workflow training with hands-on practice and ongoing support
- **Simplified Workflows**: Start with basic workflows and gradually introduce advanced features as team proficiency grows
- **Multi-Platform Strategy**: Maintain repository structure that enables migration to alternative Git platforms if needed
- **Repository Governance**: Establish clear branching strategies, review processes, and automated quality checks

---
page_texts.26:
[decisions/technology/ADR-TEC-002-ea-documentation-store.md#-positive]

### ✅ Positive

- **Centralized Source of Truth**: Single repository for all EA documentation with comprehensive version history
- **AI Engineering Enablement**: Direct API access allows AI systems to consume, analyze, and generate insights from documentation
- **Business Process Integration**: GitHub APIs enable automated reporting, compliance checking, and workflow automation
- **Professional Workflows**: Industry-standard Git workflows for collaboration and quality control
- **Automated Publishing**: Seamless integration with MkDocs platform for immediate website updates
- **Enterprise Security**: SOC 2 compliant platform with advanced security and audit features
- **Collaboration Excellence**: Pull request workflows enable structured review and improvement processes
- **Search and Discovery**: Repository search enables quick location of documentation across all content
- **Backup and Recovery**: Distributed Git architecture provides automatic backup and disaster recovery
- **Compliance**: Full audit trail of all changes meets SOX and regulatory requirements
page_texts.27:
[decisions/technology/ADR-TEC-002-ea-documentation-store.md#-negative]

### ❌ Negative

- **Learning Curve**: Team members need Git proficiency for effective collaboration
- **Workflow Complexity**: Advanced Git workflows require training and process documentation
- **Platform Dependency**: Vendor lock-in to GitHub ecosystem and pricing model
page_texts.28:
[decisions/technology/ADR-TEC-002-ea-documentation-store.md#-neutral]

### ⚪ Neutral

- **Migration Effort**: One-time effort to consolidate existing documentation into repository
